contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), possibly Constantine II (317-340), Gloria Exercitus issue of 336-340, possibly Trier mint, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [---]INVS[--]. Reverse description: two soldiers with one standard between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. In exergue: possibly TRP.…
